# Checks ↔ readiness rules

69 checks (51 readiness, 18 security) · 65 readiness rules (56 implemented in Core, 9 need Scovant Cloud's agent execution).

Core implements 56 of the 65 rules; its CLI gathers evidence for 47 today (9 of them only when the site publishes no MCP file). The other 9 read evidence this release does not gather (the WebMCP browser probe, instruction-supply registry lookups and the AI-bot policy block).

Checks are diagnostics: each reports its own verdict and evidence and carries no weight in the Technical Readiness rating (the five-domain score that was computed from checks was removed in 0.19.0). The Technical Readiness rating is computed from the Core-evaluated rules, over the same gathered evidence. The agent-only rules need an agent fetch that only Scovant Cloud performs, so Core lists them but never evaluates them. This table says, for every check, which rules read the same signal and how closely; it is curated and regenerated by `python -m scovant_core.docs --crosswalk` — do not hand-edit.

## Relationship legend

| Relationship | Meaning |
|---|---|
| same_signal | The rule reads the same evidence and judges it the same way (its scope may differ). |
| partial | The evidence overlaps; the verdicts differ (absence, fields or thresholds). |
| diagnostic_only | The matching rule is diagnostic: it reports, it does not count towards the rating. |
| no_rule | No readiness rule reads this signal. |

Experimental rules are reported but do not count toward the rating.

Tally: 2 same_signal, 25 partial, 2 diagnostic_only, 40 no_rule.

## Checks

| Check | Rules | Relationship | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| CORE-ACCESS-001 | — | no_rule | HTTPS reachability of the entry URL; no readiness rule judges it (a failed fetch leaves rules not measured). |
| CORE-ACCESS-002 | — | no_rule | robots.txt reachability and syntax only; rules read the parsed per-agent policy, which other checks cover. |
| CORE-ACCESS-003 | AI_CRAWLER_BLOCKED | partial | The check asks if search crawlers are allowed; the rule fires on a root Disallow for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended or PerplexityBot. |
| CORE-ACCESS-004 | AI-BOT-POLICY-001 | diagnostic_only | AI-BOT-POLICY-001 (diagnostic) summarises policy by intent; AI_CRAWLER_BLOCKED reads training tokens the other way, as a block. |
| CORE-ACCESS-005 | SITEMAP_MISSING_OR_INVALID | same_signal | Same sitemap probe: missing or unparsable sitemap is a finding in both. |
| CORE-ACCESS-006 | — | no_rule | Sitemap lastmod freshness; the sitemap rule judges presence and validity only. |
| CORE-ACCESS-007 | — | no_rule | Canonical URL integrity; no readiness rule reads the canonical link. |
| CORE-ACCESS-008 | BLOCKED_CRAWLABILITY | partial | Both flag noindex; the rule reads every sampled page, the check the entry page including X-Robots-Tag. |
| CORE-ACCESS-009 | LLMS_TXT_MISSING_OR_INVALID | partial | Same llms.txt document; the check does not penalise absence and checks link status, the rule fires on a missing file. |
